image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a handmade patchwork baby bib. The bib features a mix of green, yellow, and pink floral and patterned fabric squares. It has a central vertical strip of solid teal fabric with an embroidered pocket or appliqué featuring two blue eyes. The neck area has white elastic ties looped multiple times. The background is a neutral, textured beige surface.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and not a similar garment like a apron or smock.
To verify the structural integrity of the patchwork seams and ensure the ties are physically connected to the main body without fusion artifacts.
To check for subtle texture inconsistencies in the patchwork patterns or unnatural blurring in the embroidery details.

focus_areas: Connection points of the white elastic ties to the main fabric body
Consistency of stitching lines across different fabric patches
Logical coherence of the patchwork patterns (do they align naturally?)
Clarity and physical plausibility of the central embroidered feature
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the white elastic ties at the top. AI generators often struggle with complex looping structures like these; check if they merge into the background or each other unnaturally. Also, inspect the central 'face' embroidery – does it look like thread on fabric, or is it a printed artifact that lacks depth? Verify that the patchwork seams show realistic shadowing and thickness.
